items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but well below all-time highs; Argus believes supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, lowering lithium companies' targets following recent spot price weakness, though BMO views the group as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in electric vehicles and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory and expected supply increases.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike; the proposal must be ratified by a member vote.
